items.title: SpaceX unveils Starbase launch site in Louisiana, moves up orbital data center launch timeline
items.summary: Elon Musk is doing what he always does: making aggressive capex moves and pushing up timelines. SpaceX on Tuesday announced Starbase, Louisiana, a "high cadence" launch site that will eventually support "thousands" of Starship launches a year.

items.title: The Two Humanoid-Robot Funds Are 30 Points Apart This Year. The Winner Owns the Parts, Not the Promises
items.summary: Two humanoid-robot ETFs track the same explosive theme yet delivered wildly different results in 2026, and the gap comes down to one fundamental disagreement about how to bet on the robots actually getting built.

items.title: The Robo-Taxi Championship Bout Is Set: Tesla vs. Waymo
items.summary: Alphabet’s Waymo is taking its robo-taxis to Germany. Tesla is working on getting its autonomous driving software approved overseas.

items.title: Tesla Is Worth Twenty-Five Times More Than Ford
items.summary: Ford sells America's best-selling vehicle and dominates the truck market, yet its entire company is valued at a sliver of what investors hand Tesla. The gap between those two realities raises a question worth sitting with.
